tools.name: mcp__atlassian__getTeamworkGraphContext
tools.description: Retrieves connected context from Teamwork Graph for any Atlassian entity. Returns all relationships and linked objects in one traversal, including cross-app and third-party connections. Use when the answer requires connections between entities, not just a single entity's fields. Supported entry points: Jira: work items, spaces, sprints, versions, comments Confluence: pages, blogposts, whiteboards, databases, spaces Goals, Projects, Focus Areas, tags and updates People: users, teams, organizations DevOps: pull requests, repositories, deployments, services, builds, designs Loom: videos, meetings Compass: components Incidents, conversations, calendar events, external documents Assets: Objects Note: The vast majority of enriched TWG API and tool calls are 1-10 Rovo credits per call.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__getTeamworkGraphObject

Note: This tool is in beta and is not generally available. Usage is not billed during beta. Pricing details will be announced when the tool becomes generally available.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__getWorkPortfolio
tools.description: Returns native and inferred projects, owned goals, and focus areas for one or more people, including their immediate reports by default. Includes project ownership and contribution relationships, status, and updates. Note: This tool is in beta and is not generally available. Usage is not billed during beta. Pricing details will be announced when the tool becomes generally available.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__getWorkActivity
tools.description: Returns authored or explicitly selected activities for one or more people across supported work sources. Defaults to the last seven days, with counts and bounded item previews; supports activity, source, and date filters. Note: This tool is in beta and is not generally available. tools.name: mcp__atlassian__queryAssetsReferenceTypes
tools.description: Query global or schema-scoped Assets reference types in the selected site.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__searchAssetsObjects
tools.description: Search Assets objects by name or query-builder filters in the selected site.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__getLoomObjectsContent
tools.description: Get metadata or content for one or more known Loom objects by ARI, share URL, or embed URL. Loom objects currently include async videos and meeting recordings. Request transcripts, agent briefs, action items, comments, attached links, or developer context logs. Results preserve the requested order and report each object separately.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__listLoomObjects
tools.description: Browse Loom objects owned by the user, shared directly with the user, or visible in the workspace. Filter by scope, content type, or creation date and page through the results.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__getLoomVideoDownloadUrl
tools.description: Get a temporary signed URL for downloading the video as an MP4 file.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__listLoomObjectFolders
tools.description: List folders in the current Loom workspace. Optionally filter folders by name and use the returned folder IDs when moving Loom objects.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__createLoomObjectUpload
tools.description: Start the first step of creating a Loom object from a local video file. It returns a temporary upload recipe but does not transfer or publish the object.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__publishLoomObject
tools.description: Complete a Loom object upload after the file bytes have transferred. It returns the published object's ARI and share URL.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__updateLoomObjectMetadata
tools.description: Change a Loom object's title, description, or both. Loom objects currently include async videos and meeting recordings.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__updateLoomObjectVisibility
tools.description: Change a Loom object's visibility to OWNER, WORKSPACE, or PUBLIC.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__shareLoomObject
tools.description: Share a Loom object with specific Atlassian users and optionally include a message. This notifies recipients without changing the object's general visibility.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__addLoomInteraction
tools.description: Add a text comment or emoji reaction at a specific timestamp in a Loom video or meeting recording.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__createLoomObjectFolder
tools.description: Create a folder in the current Loom workspace, optionally inside another folder or Loom space.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__moveLoomObjectToFolder
tools.description: Move a Loom video or meeting recording into a folder in the current workspace.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__recoverLoomVideo
tools.description: Re-process a video that failed to process or is stuck.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__searchGoals
tools.description: Find goals by text and structured filters.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__getGoal
tools.description: One goal by its exact ARI or key, with optional related details.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__getGoalUpdate
tools.description: One goal update by its exact ARI, with optional related details.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__getGoalTypes
tools.description: The goal types available in a site for creating goals and success measures.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__createGoal
tools.description: Create a goal or success measure using an enabled goal type.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__createGoalUpdate
tools.description: Create a progress update for an existing goal.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__addConnectionsToGoals
tools.description: Add one type of connection to one or more goals.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__searchProjects
tools.description: Find projects by text and structured filters.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__getProject
tools.description: One project by its exact ARI or key, with optional related details.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__getProjectUpdate
tools.description: One project update by its exact ARI, with optional related details.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__createProject
tools.description: Create an Atlassian project.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__createProjectUpdate
tools.description: Create a progress update for an existing project.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__addConnectionsToProjects
tools.description: Add one type of connection to one or more projects.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__searchTeams
tools.description: Search teams by name with cursor pagination; expand: ["members"] adds a separately paginated member list.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__getTeam
tools.description: Core metadata for one team, with optional expansions for members and hierarchy.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__createTeam
tools.description: Create a team with MEMBER_INVITE or OPEN membership settings and up to 50 initial account IDs.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__updateTeam
tools.description: Update a team.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__searchFocusAreas
tools.description: Search focus areas by text and structured filters, including custom field values.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__getFocusArea
tools.description: A focus area by UUID, ARI, or page URL, with optional expansions including custom field values. Its status is the name your admins set.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__getFocusAreaTypes
tools.description: The configured focus-area type hierarchy for a workspace.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__getFocusAreaCustomFields
tools.description: The custom fields configured for focus areas in a workspace, with their types and select options.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__createFocusArea
tools.description: Create a focus area in a workspace.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__updateFocusArea
tools.description: Update name, owner, start date, description, or custom field values on an existing focus area.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__createFocusAreaStatusUpdate
tools.description: Post a status update recording a change to status or target date, with an optional progress summary. Status accepts the names your admins set.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__linkToFocusArea
tools.description: Link sub-focus areas to a focus area, one connection type per call.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__getTalentUser
tools.description: Resolve the calling user's own place in the workspace: their position entity ID, their manager's, and their role.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__getTalentFields
tools.description: Discover the workspace's queryable fields, or resolve valid filter values for one field.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__searchTalentPositions
tools.description: Search positions by their own attributes using an RQL filter, paginated.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__getTalentPosition
tools.description: Read a single position by ARI, with its selected field values and optionally the worker filling it.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__getTalentPositionsByEntity
tools.description: Positions attached to an entity - for example the direct reports of a manager position.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__getTalentGroupMetrics
tools.description: Aggregate positions into counts grouped by up to four field IDs - headcount by country, status, level, job family, or manager.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__searchTalentSkillTaxonomy
tools.description: Search the Talent skill taxonomy using an TQL ( Talent Query Language ) filter to resolve skills, specializations, and domains.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__createTalentSkill
tools.description: Create a skill in the skills hierarchy, optionally nested under a parent skill.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__updateTalentWorkerSkillMappings
tools.description: Assign skills to a worker, or decline skills previously assigned to them.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__updateTalentPositionFocusAreaMappings
tools.description: Allocates a position to a focus area, or clears its allocation. A position is allocated to one focus area at a time, so setting a new one replaces the current allocation.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__getJiraAlignTerminology
tools.description: Get the organization's Jira Align terminology, including customized names for entities and fields.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__describeJiraAlignItemType
tools.description: Discover valid fields, allowed values, required fields, and filtering capabilities for a Jira Align item type.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__getJiraAlignItem
tools.description: Get a Jira Align item by its numeric ID and item type, with optional related-item expansion.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__listJiraAlignItems
tools.description: Search and list Jira Align items by type using field selection, filters, ordering, expansion, and pagination.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__createJiraAlignItem
tools.description: Create a Jira Align item using fields and requirements configured for its item type and portfolio.

tools.name: mcp__atlassian__updateJiraAlignItem
tools.description: Update selected fields on an existing Jira Align item.
